manifest.name: Player Queues
manifest.description: Configuration of the core player queue management module

crossfade_duration.label: Standard crossfade duration
crossfade_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the standard crossfade between tracks.

crossfade_mode.label: Crossfade mode
crossfade_mode.description: The crossfade type to use when crossfade is enabled. Smart crossfade beat-matches tracks and needs the smart fades analysis provider on a capable system; it falls back to standard when unavailable.

disabled_reasons.smart_crossfade: Not available on this server: smart crossfade needs the smart fades analysis provider and a larger audio buffer (balanced or higher).

volume_normalization.label: Enable volume normalization (EBU-R128 based)
volume_normalization.description: Enable volume normalization based on the EBU-R128 standard without affecting dynamic range

default_enqueue_select_artist.label: Items to select when you play a (in-library) artist.

options.library_tracks: In-library tracks for the artist only
options.prefer_library: Prefer library, fall back to top

default_enqueue_select_album.label: Items to select when you play a (in-library) album.

options.all_tracks: All tracks for album on (streaming) provider
